seo.landingTitle: Tax reform 2026–2033: what changes for your company
seo.landingDescription: CBS is charged from 01/01/2027. See what changes from 2026 to 2033 and take the free tax reform diagnostic for your company.

landing.title: CBS starts being charged on 01/01/2027.

landing.sectorsLink: See what changes in my sector
landing.changesTitle: Five changes that reach your company's cash
landing.timelineTitle: Eight years of transition. Each one with a different bill.
landing.news: Business groups asked to delay CBS collection to 2028 (news of 04/11/2026). Until the law changes, 01/01/2027 stands.

ibs.title: IBS
ibs.text: State and municipal, replaces ICMS and ISS, run by the Managing Committee.

selective.title: Selective tax
selective.text: On goods harmful to health or the environment, from 2027.

splitPayment.title: Split payment
splitPayment.text: The tax is collected when the payment settles, and it moves your cash.

credit.title: Broad credit
credit.text: Financial credit on purchases, when the supplier's tax was paid.

years.y2026: Test year: CBS 0.9% and IBS 0.1% shown on the invoice, offset against PIS/Cofins. Not for Simples.
years.y2027: CBS charged in full, PIS/Cofins abolished, the selective tax starts. IBS at 0.1%.
years.y2028: IBS stays at 0.1% (0.05% state and 0.05% municipal).
years.y2029: ICMS and ISS fall to 9/10 while IBS rises.
years.y2032: ICMS and ISS at 6/10; ICMS benefits compensated until here.
years.y2033: ICMS and ISS abolished. Full IBS and CBS.

simulator.title: Impact simulator 2026–2033
simulator.lede: How the burden on revenue changes year by year: PIS/Cofins, ICMS and ISS leave, CBS and IBS come in. From {first} in 2026 to {last} in 2033 · estimate with reference rates, not a tax calculation.

simulator.splitText: IBS and CBS leave at the payment of the sale, before the monthly due date: working capital the company goes without for about a month.
